# tenarium_tenant_role (Resource)

A custom role of a tenant: a name for a set of action patterns, usable like the built-in member roles.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tenarium_tenant_role" "support" {
  tenant_id   = tenarium_tenant.acme.id
  name        = "support"
  description = "Read-only access for the support team"
  actions     = ["members:read", "usage:read", "webhooks:read"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `actions` (Set of String) Action patterns the role grants, e.g. `members:read` or `webhooks:*`.
- `name` (String) Lowercase role identifier; must not be a built-in role. Changing it replaces the role.
- `tenant_id` (String) ID (or slug) of the tenant. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<tenant_id>/<name>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import tenarium_tenant_role.support <tenant_id>/support
```
